data.one_liner: Convert any Flutter widget into high-quality images with customizable formats and settings.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to wrap any Flutter widget and convert it into image byte formats like PNG, JPEG, or raw data using a controller. It supports custom pixel ratios, quality controls, animation waiting, and lifecycle callbacks.
use_when: You need to export a custom-built Flutter widget or UI component as an image file or bytes.
You are building features like receipt generators, social sharing cards, or dynamic badge creators within your app.
avoid_when: You only need to load and display static image assets or network images.
You are looking for a complete image picker or cropper tool.
strengths: Supports multiple formats including PNG, JPEG, Raw RGBA, and Raw Unmodified.
Cross-platform support across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Includes helpful utilities like `WidgetsToImageBuilder` and dedicated convenience methods.
weaknesses: Limited to converting rendered widgets currently mounted in the widget tree.
Complex animations or off-screen rendering may require specific configuration delays.
